title: How he came to Blanche Calloway, Claude Hopkins, Benny Carter and Basie
summary: Avery Baker recommended him to Blanche Calloway, then he spent years with Claude Hopkins, a stint with Benny Carter, and two or three stays with Basie.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: How did Blanche know about you?
She had a -- there was a guy that used to play with Zack White, named Avery Baker (PHONETIC) --

Yeah. Avery Baker (PHONETIC). And he recommended me to her. So I stayed with her for about -- oh I guess about three or four years. Three or four years and then I joined Claude Hopkins (PHONETIC). And we worked hard

for about three or four years. Then I went with Benny Carter (PHONETIC). For a year or so -- a couple of years maybe. And I was with -- then I went with Count Basie (PHONETIC) a couple of times you know. Two or three times.
And then you would leave and come back and --
